typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	toOTCTRADEAUDITING_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		GROUP_NAME as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		TRADE_ACTION as string,
		CREATE_DTE as timestamp,
		GROUP_ASSIGNED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBCalypso
OLEDBCalypso derive(oGROUP_NAME = GROUP_NAME,
		oGROUP_ASSIGNED = GROUP_ASSIGNED,
		oCREATE_DTE = CREATE_DTE,
		oTRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		oTRADE_ACTION = TRADE_ACTION) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Group_Assigned as string,
		Audit_Action as string,
		Group_Name as string,
		Original_Status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Create_Dte = oCREATE_DTE,
		Group_Assigned = oGROUP_ASSIGNED,
		Audit_Action = oTRADE_ACTION,
		Group_Name = oGROUP_NAME,
		Original_Status = oTRADE_STATUS),
	partitionFileNames:[($toOTCTRADEAUDITING_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toOTCTRADEAUDITING
